identification: Work/sewing table veneered in strongly figured tiger (fiddleback) blond timber, catalogued as satinwood. The figure looks just as much like tiger maple or Karelian/flame birch, so the piece may be Biedermeier/Baltic or a later revival. Rectangular top with ebonised edge, end drawer with two small knobs, pull-out velvet-covered workbox under the top, trestle end supports on platform feet with ebonised stringing, ebonised bun feet, single turned stretcher. H70 W70 D43. One knob missing per catalogue; velvet faded and worn. Estimate $150-250, current bid $80 (27 Nov).

viewing_check: Timber ID (satinwood is yellow with ribbon figure and heavy; maple/birch is lighter and paler). Check the drawer dovetails (hand-cut or machine), whether the velvet box still has a frame and its runners work, and the missing knob. Look under the top for any maker or retailer label.
